A dog is a domesticated mammal from the family Canidae and is a subspecies of the gray wolf. Known scientifically as Canis lupus familiaris, dogs have been bred by humans for thousands of years for various purposes, including companionship, work, and protection. They are known for their loyalty, intelligence, and ability to form strong bonds with humans. Dogs come in a wide variety of breeds, each with its own unique characteristics, such as size, coat type, and temperament.
